annotations.title: Set a website page’s navigation visibility

description: Hide or show one selected page in the site navigation using hidden_from_nav. Existing changes need the displayed if_unchanged revision from soclo_page_pages. Free: spends no credits. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves the exact change. Saved changes are visible immediately on a live site. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_pages and soclo_page_versions before retrying.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

hidden_from_nav.description: Whether the selected page is hidden from the site navigation.

id.description: The selected page id from soclo_page_pages.

if_unchanged.description: Exact displayed site, page-list or History revision, as last read; never refresh it invisibly.

name: soclo_page_set_visibility
title: Set a website page’s navigation visibility
